hints.title: Segment Tree Node Matrix
hints.text: Model each segment tree node to store product modulo k and a remainder transition count array.

hints.title: Associative Merge Property
hints.text: When combining left and right tree segments, the product is the product of sub-products modulo k, and remainders combine via modular shifts.

hints.title: Dynamic Range Inquiries
hints.text: Update tree values at query points and query the segment from start index to n - 1.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def resultArray(self, nums: list[int], k: int, queries: list[list[int]]) -> list[int]:
        nums = [x % k for x in nums]
        n = len(nums)
        ans = []
        for q in queries:
            idx, val, start, x = q[0], q[1] % k, q[2], q[3]
            nums[idx] = val
            prod = 1
            cnt = 0
            for i in range(start, n):
                prod = (prod * nums[i]) % k
                if prod == x:
                    cnt += 1
            ans.append(cnt)
        return ans
```

complexity.notes: Query range simulation tracks running modular prefix products.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recomputing all prefix subarrays from scratch per query without bounded iteration times out.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Linear storage maintains the dynamic array state.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Understand modular product aggregation and range query updates.
